sheets.prompt: Character design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one crawler, a small defunct scout droid of an ancient vanished civilisation, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view, and its alarm wind-up reared back on its hind legs with its eye flaring. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade backpack stands beside it for scale; the crawler is knee-high to the traveller. Design: a round ceramic body like a half-buried dome on four jointed legs, one large round amber eye in front, a short antenna; pale ivory ceramic panels over dark joints; weathered, chipped and stained with age, glowing amber seams. Curious and twitchy. Original design, medium detail, a strong readable silhouette. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream paper grain, evenly spaced views, fully visible bodies, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, scenery, hollow knight, white mask, drapes, bandages, mummy, robes, gore.
